event_scope: Four transition windows and 72 monthly sessions, not every event across the six-year diagnostic

source_claim_status.claim: Scoped native historical transition values and 72 underfilled monthly population counts; public resolver actual code behavior
Complete historical member population; deployed CUSIP mapping spans/provenance and candidate omission certificate

request.query: WITH h AS (SELECT accession,COUNT(*) AS rows,COUNT(DISTINCT infoTableSk) AS unique_rows,COUNT(DISTINCT cusip) AS cusips,SUM(CASE WHEN resolvedTicker IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS resolved_rows,COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN resolvedTicker IS NULL THEN cusip END) AS unresolved_cusips FROM lake.institutional_holdings WHERE availableAt>=CAST(? AS TIMESTAMP) AND availableAt<=CAST(? AS TIMESTAMP) GROUP BY accession) SELECT f.accession,f.cik,f.periodOfReport,f.availableAt,f.submissionType,f.amendmentType,h.* EXCLUDE(accession) FROM lake.institutional_filings f JOIN h USING(accession) WHERE f.periodOfReport IN ('2015-06-30','2015-09-30') AND f.availableAt<TIMESTAMP '2015-12-01' ORDER BY periodOfReport,cik,availableAt

AS TIMESTAMP) GROUP BY accession) SELECT f.accession,f.cik,f.periodOfReport,f.availableAt,f.submissionType,f.amendmentType,h.* EXCLUDE(accession) FROM lake.institutional_filings f JOIN h USING(accession) WHERE f.periodOfReport IN ('2017-06-30','2017-09-30') AND f.availableAt<TIMESTAMP '2017-12-01' ORDER BY periodOfReport,cik,availableAt

WITH h AS (SELECT accession,COUNT(*) AS rows,COUNT(DISTINCT infoTableSk) AS unique_rows,COUNT(DISTINCT cusip) AS cusips,SUM(CASE WHEN resolvedTicker IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS resolved_rows,COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN resolvedTicker IS NULL THEN cusip END) AS unresolved_cusips FROM lake.institutional_holdings WHERE availableAt>=CAST(? AS TIMESTAMP) AND availableAt<=CAST(? AS TIMESTAMP) GROUP BY accession) SELECT f.accession,f.cik,f.periodOfReport,f.availableAt,f.submissionType,f.amendmentType,h.* EXCLUDE(accession) FROM lake.institutional_filings f JOIN h USING(accession) WHERE f.periodOfReport IN ('2020-06-30','2020-09-30') AND f.availableAt<TIMESTAMP '2020-12-01' ORDER BY periodOfReport,cik,availableAt

SELECT ticker,security_id,canonical_symbol,share_class_figi,cik,asset_type,from_date,LEAST(COALESCE(to_date,DATE '2020-12-31'),DATE '2020-12-31') AS to_date FROM lake.security_segments WHERE COALESCE(to_date,DATE '2020-12-31')>=CAST(? AS DATE) AND from_date<=CAST(? AS DATE) ORDER BY ticker,from_date

SELECT indexCode,indexName,componentCode,componentName,startDate,LEAST(COALESCE(endDate,TIMESTAMP '2020-12-31 23:59:59'),TIMESTAMP '2020-12-31 23:59:59') AS endDate FROM lake.index_constituents WHERE indexCode='GSPC' AND (endDate IS NULL OR endDate>=CAST(? AS TIMESTAMP)) AND startDate<=CAST(? AS TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY componentCode,startDate

WITH h AS (SELECT accession, COUNT(*) AS rows, COUNT(DISTINCT infoTableSk) AS unique_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT cusip) AS cusips, SUM(CASE WHEN resolvedTicker IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS resolved_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN resolvedTicker IS NULL THEN cusip END) AS unresolved_cusips FROM lake.institutional_holdings WHERE availableAt>=CAST(? AS TIMESTAMP) AND availableAt<=CAST(? AS TIMESTAMP) GROUP BY accession) SELECT f.accession,f.cik,f.periodOfReport,f.availableAt,f.submissionType,f.amendmentType,h.* EXCLUDE(accession) FROM lake.institutional_filings f JOIN h USING(accession) WHERE f.periodOfReport IN ('2015-06-30','2015-09-30','2017-06-30','2017-09-30','2020-06-30','2020-09-30') AND f.availableAt<CAST(f.periodOfReport AS TIMESTAMP)+INTERVAL 61 DAY ORDER BY periodOfReport,cik,availableAt

SELECT h.resolvedTicker,h.cusip,s.security_id,s.share_class_figi,s.cik,s.from_date,LEAST(COALESCE(s.to_date,DATE '2020-12-31'),DATE '2020-12-31') AS to_date, MIN(h.availableAt) AS first_public,MAX(h.availableAt) AS last_public,COUNT(*) AS rows FROM lake.institutional_holdings h LEFT JOIN lake.security_segments s ON h.resolvedTicker=s.ticker AND CAST(h.availableAt AS DATE) BETWEEN s.from_date AND COALESCE(s.to_date,DATE '2020-12-31') WHERE h.availableAt>=CAST(? AS TIMESTAMP) AND h.availableAt<=CAST(? AS TIMESTAMP) AND h.resolvedTicker IN ('AAPL','MSFT','IBM','XOM','JNJ','JPM','GE','F','WMT','KO','AAL','TSLA') GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY h.resolvedTicker,h.cusip,s.from_date
